name: Pagination
description: Numeric pagination with prev/next and boundary jumps; accepts page/pageCount or currentPage/totalPages and derives the count (plus a Showing X-Y of Z summary) from total/pageSize.
designIntent: Pagination lets users navigate through paged content. It shows page numbers with ellipsis for large ranges, prev/next buttons, and marks the current page with aria-current=page.

props.name: pageCount
props.description: Total pages. Alias: totalPages, or derived from total/pageSize.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Rows per page; with total enables the summary and derives pageCount.

props.name: total
props.description: Total item count for the summary.

props.name: showSummary
props.description: Force the summary on/off (defaults on when total and pageSize are set).

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called with the new page number.

props.name: siblings
props.description: Page buttons shown around the current page.

props.name: labels
props.type: { pagination?: string; first?: string; previous?: string; next?: string; last?: string; page?: (page: number) => string }

examples.title: Summary + derived pages
examples.description: Renders "Showing 26–50 of 312 students" and derives 13 pages.

examples.title: Wide page range
examples.description: Show more page buttons around the current page

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Pagination for infinite scroll content
antiPatterns.explanation: Pagination implies discrete pages. Use a 'Load more' button or infinite scroll for continuous content.

antiPatterns.title: Don't hide the current page number
antiPatterns.explanation: Users need to know where they are. Always show the active page with aria-current=page.

accessibility.userRequirements: Don't place multiple paginations on one page
Update aria-current when the page changes

accessibility.implementation: Prev/next are disabled at the boundaries
accessibility.userRequirements: Disabled buttons are removed from tab order
